EmailTemplate.name: School of Music Admission Decision - MUSIC MINOR
EmailTemplate.subject: ASU School of Music Admission Decision
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We are pleased to inform you that you have passed your audition on INSTRUMENT and are now accepted as a Music Performance Minor in the School of Music in the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts at Arizona State University. If you have not already done so, please review the Music Performance Minor course requirements here. To officially add the minor, please contact your major area advisor to schedule an appointment. You should bring this letter as confirmation that you are admitted into the Music Performance Minor.
Sincerely,
Julie Stephens Coordinator, Academic Affairs + Admissions Arizona State University | Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts P.O. Box 870405 | Tempe, Arizona 85287-0405 Phone: 480-965-5069 {!Case.Thread_Id}
